<h2>Load Named Configuration</h2>

<h3>Description</h3>

<p>Loads one complete resolved project configuration by its identifier.
</p>


<h3>Usage</h3>

<pre><code class='language-R'>load_config(config_id, file = here::here("config.yml"))
</code></pre>


<h3>Arguments</h3>

<table role = "presentation">
<tr><td><code id="config_id">config_id</code></td>
<td>
<p>Single non-empty configuration identifier declared in the YAML file.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="file">file</code></td>
<td>
<p>Path to the generated YAML configuration file.</p>
</td></tr>
</table>


<h3>Details</h3>

<p>Use [load_config_value()] when only one nested configuration value is needed.
This function is the canonical project boundary around [config::get()] for
complete named configurations.
</p>


<h3>Value</h3>

<p>The complete resolved named configuration.
</p>


<h3>See Also</h3>

<p>[load_config_value()], [load_active_config_value()]
</p>

</main>
